name: Canaria-Phase3B-stronger-teacher-regression-exploration-v1

data.normalization: features and target standardized from training subset only
data.test_policy: test indices are split off but test tensors/targets are not evaluated or used by Stage A

architecture: unchanged from completed Phase 3: input->Linear64+GELU->4 residual MLP blocks (LayerNorm, Linear128, GELU, Linear64)->Linear1

selection.candidate_gate: mean validation R2 >= 0.35 AND mean validation R2 >= baseline mean validation R2 + 0.10
selection.winner: eligible recipe with highest mean validation R2; ties within 1e-12 use lower across-seed standard deviation, then earlier recipe_grid order

stopping_rule: If no recipe passes the candidate gate, STOP Phase 3B and record Stage A as a negative calibration result. Do not change architecture or inspect test to rescue the experiment.
stage_b_boundary: If Stage A passes, commit a separate confirmatory protocol before generating any fresh Stage B outcomes. Proposed fresh seeds are 2400-2407; they are not confirmatory until that protocol is locked.
